title.narrative: Contribution to the Convention Against Torture Initiative (CTI) 2021-22

description.narrative: The CTI-project is an intergovernmental cross-regional initiative launched in 2014 by Chile, Denmark, Fiji (from 2019), Ghana, Indonesia and Morocco. The strategic objective is to achieve enhanced implementation of the Convention against Torture by 2024. The immediate objectives are: 1) to identify challenges and barriers to implementation of the UNCAT in developing countries and 2) to address these obstacles through inter-state capacity building, assistance and dialogue. Denmark's funding covers the costs of the administrative management of the CTI-project and the implementation of activities related to developing countries.
